Lazy fetch and replacement objects are disabled on both internal paths. Native official Agent inheritance is not changed by this constructor hardening.

verified_source_observations.evidence: retained_storage requires the retained repository path to equal its canonical directory path and rejects any existing commondir, objects/info/alternates, shallow or info/grafts entry using symlink_metadata. The check runs before capture fetch, after capture fetch and before verify's exact refs/graph/fsck commands.
